# T13 Rust test numeric ledger

All dimensions/angles/benchmark choices are synthetic; none estimates a real wing. Rational multiples of pi are independent analytic expectations from the cited lifting-line equations. Pi and the theoretical section input 2*pi are mathematical/theoretical quantities, not invented measurements. NaN/infinity and usize::MAX deliberately test invalid inputs. Counts and tolerances are software tests, not physical validity thresholds. Signs appear in the source expression.
